messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Pilot account ClearHarbor surfaced three repeated asks during onboarding this week: 1) per-route cost breakdown in the Console, 2) ability to pin an embedding model per-route, 3) an onboarding checklist with default prompt templates. They said if we don't show any per-route visibility within ~2 weeks they may push renewal. Thoughts on prioritization?

Devon (PM): Thanks Maya. High signal — can you paste a couple of the exact customer quotes or short examples? Also any screenshots or notes about which routes/endpoints they care about? Helps size impact.

Maya (CS): Sure — pulled from 3 kickoff calls: 
- "We need to see cost per endpoint so we can bill our internal teams. Right now it's a black box."
- "If embedding costs spike we need to pin a more efficient model per route."
- "A checklist with recommended starter prompts and rate limits would have saved us a day."
They specifically called out two routes: `inbox-summarize` and `search-embeddings`. Came up in 3 of 4 onboarding sessions this week.

Devon (PM): Ok — sounds actionable. My suggested triage: 
- Quick win: onboarding checklist + prompt templates (ship within a week)
- Mid: CSV export/one-off per-route cost report (fast to ship)
- Long: Console per-route cost UI + rollup in billing (roadmap item)
I'll loop in Lena and Tom. @Lena @Tom can you weigh in on feasibility/estimates? :eyes:

Lena (Product): Agree with that breakdown. Per-route cost UI is Q2 roadmap-level work, but we can absolutely ship a CSV export as an interim measure. Checklist + templates = low effort, high impact for renewals.

Tom (Eng): For the CSV export we'll need to add `route_id` to the billing aggregation pipeline and expose a simple endpoint. Rough estimate: 3 working days for a CSV export (query + lambda + auth), 2 sprints for full UI with dashboards and filters. Example query we can run as a stopgap:

```sql
SELECT route_id, DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) as day, SUM(cost_cents) as cost_cents
FROM billing_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-01' AND account_id = 'clearharbor'
GROUP BY route_id, day;
```

Maya (CS): Perfect — I'll collect 5 concrete examples and share them in the ticket. Recommend we mark ClearHarbor as "at-risk" if no cost visibility by 2026-04-07 (two weeks). Also request an enablement slide deck + one-pager for CSMs to set expectations.

Devon (PM): Please open a ticket with label `cs:feedback` and attach the quotes. I'll create a short story for the checklist and flag the CSV export as P0 quick-win. Thanks! :pray:

OpsBot: JIRA ticket CS-4821 created by Maya (CS) — "Per-route cost CSV export for ClearHarbor" — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-4821

Tom (Eng): Noted. I'll pick up the CSV export task after current sprint wrap; will post a PR link here when ready.

Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll post the enablement draft here later today and ping ClearHarbor with interim expectations. :thumbsup:
